steps.content: In the Chief's office, steam rises from two cups of hot tea.
Poffy stands in front of your office desk with her head lowered, occasionally stealing guilty glances at you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Miss Poffy, this is your final warning. According to your contract, you must continue to fulfill your streaming obligations.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Any breach of contract will result in serious losses to the Company. In such an event, in addition to paying substantial liquidated damages, you will also bear full legal responsibility. The Company reserves all rights to pursue legal action and hold you accountable.
You finish reading out the notice, then look up at Poffy.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Now, can you explain your reason for coming to the Bureau?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Oh dear, nothing escapes you, Chief...
Poffy sticks out her tongue, trying to charm her way out of trouble by acting cutesy.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: My admirable, kind-hearted, and merciful Chief! Could you please just let this poor, innocent, and penniless Sinner hide in here for a while?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: The Bureau has detained soooo many Sinners already. What's one more, right?

You wave the bill in your hand. The number of zeros trailing the figure is staggering. The paper flutters to the ground, and Poffy lunges forward to snatch it up, crumples it into a ball, and hurls it into the trash.
She doesn't get up. Instead, she wraps her arms around your leg and breaks down in heart-wrenching sobs.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Chief, you've got to help me!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Quit rolling around on the ground and clinging to people's legs...
You reach out to help her up, but notice her body is trembling slightly.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: They... they're bad people who'll do anything for money!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: They would lock me in a streaming room and make me eat all kinds of weird food, then just keep filming videos, nonstop...
Her words come in broken fragments, as if she's remembering something terrible. She's fighting against the memories this notice has awakened and everything she refuses to face.
Seeing her distress, you finally realize this isn't some act, but a genuine cry for help. You drop your teasing tone, your voice turning serious.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you're being exploited, why not seek legal action?
Poffy shakes her head vigorously.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: It won't work... It's not that simple...

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Sob... If you don't let me stay, I'll be hunted down by those debt collector thugs, or get captured by the company again! It's horrible! Those were portions even I couldn't finish... I really can't gorge myself like that anymore!
Poffy cries for a long time until her stomach begins growling with hunger. She then asks timidly if she could go to the cafeteria to eat something. You nod and ask Nightingale to help comfort her.
After she's left, you call for Mr. Fox.

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: I've reviewed the contract. It's fully legally binding. Once signed, there's virtually no way to get out unscathed.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: From what I understand, she appears to have suffered severe psychological oppression and physical abuse.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is there really no way at all?

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: Who do you think I am? Of course there's a way, but it's one I wouldn't recommend.

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: Or, she could fulfill her contractual obligations for now and complete her current assignments. Then we'll find a way to get her out with minimal consequences.

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: You could pose as Miss Poffy's guardian or assistant and visit her workplace. We might uncover something useful.
Mr. Fox smiles, his eyes behind his glasses narrowing into gleaming slits.

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: This sort of thing is right up your alley, isn't it, Chief?
You pretend not to catch his teasing tone and carefully consider the plan. Finally, you let out a sigh.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is the best option we have right now. At least... it's worth a shot.
[Scene Change]
Early the next morning, Poffy leads you to MCN's building.
Outside the fancy corporate tower, employees in immaculate business attire stride past with hurried steps, while Poffy beside you desperately tries to shrink behind your back, unwilling to be seen.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Ugh... Just being back here makes my stomach hurt...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Poffy, can I ask you a question?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Oh, sure. Go ahead.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're a huge foodie. Isn't streaming yourself enjoying delicious food exactly what you'd want?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: That's what I thought at first, so I signed the contract... But things turned out very differently.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Sigh, I don't really know how to explain it, Chief. You'll see for yourself in a bit.
Poffy uses her staff card to get you two into the building, then the elevator takes you up to a certain floor.
[Scene Change]

The chaos before you is shocking. Decorations and clothes hangers are scattered across the floor, while staff members navigate through the mess with practiced ease, as if this disorder were perfectly routine.
Hey, Poffy! Stop dawdling around over there!
Poffy instinctively ducks behind you, but the speaker has already stridden forward and grabs her shoulder, dragging her directly toward the makeup room.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hey! What are you doing?
So you're that so-called assistant of hers?
The man gives you a cold, appraising look, then turns his attention to Poffy, his tone growing even icier.
If you need something, make a proper request to the company. You can't just hire someone on a whim.

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: How many times have I told you? I'm your manager. You need to clear everything with me first.
Poffy's lips twitch, but she can't get a single word out. You catch her eye and signal for her to stay calm.

The manager shoves her into the chair in front of the makeup station, and the makeup artists immediately swarm around her. He keeps refreshing work documents on his device while continuing to grumble about Poffy.

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: Do you have any idea how much money you've cost the company by disappearing these past few days?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: But you literally told me that the company didn't give a damn about me...

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: ...And now you've learned to talk back! Sure, you're useless, but still one of our products. Have you ever seen a product on a shelf just up and disappear whenever it wants?!

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: You're going to make up for every stream and sponsor you've missed. I'm booking you for both day streams and night streams. Pull an all-nighter if you have to, I don't care!
You can barely stand listening to all this, but meanwhile Poffy just hangs her head as she recites the ad copy, her expression completely numb.

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: Get ready, rolling in! Fill lights over here!
[White Screen Transition]

Click! The massive fill lights blind your eyes, making them water reflexively. But Poffy, standing directly in their glare, suddenly springs to life as if someone has just flipped her power switch on.
Tucking away her earlier timidity and anxiety, she straightens her posture and instantly switches into her streamer mode with a beaming smile, greeting the audience beyond the camera professionally.
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Hey everyone, long time no see! I look chubbier? Wow, can't hide anything from you guys, can I? I've been eating well lately, indeed!
She makes a heart gesture at the camera, playfully bantering with her fans before smoothly transitioning to the main topic.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Ta-da! Today's mukbang challenge: Rating Cursed Food! Are these suspicious-looking dishes actually edible?

The camera pulls back to reveal her streaming studio setup. Spread across the table are a purple-black jelly, some fluorescent green sushi, a charcoal pudding, and fried durian... All of the dishes are unnaturally colored, and their strange aromas mix in the air.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Whoa, the colors don't look too pleasant!
She holds up a piece of jelly and gives it a shake for the camera, its slimy texture gleaming with an ominous sheen under the studio lights.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Doesn't this purple thing look like an alien brain? Chat, can I get some encouragement please!
You glance at the stream's real-time analytics and see her views instantly rocket to #1 in the food category.
After hyping up her audience, Poffy heroically swallows the jelly, her smile freezing. A crew member turns away to dry heave, while Poffy quickly recovers and continues her commentary.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Hmm... this tastes like... the tears shed after durian and glue had a breakup.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: As for the texture... it's all gooey and sticky, like biting into a broken pencil tip. But hey, it's still perfectly edible!
Next up is the fluorescent green sushi.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: It tastes like detergent mixed with wasabi. My mouth feels like it's just been deep-cleansed. Way too intense! My stomach's screaming!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Honestly, this stuff's better suited for an April Fools prank. I wouldn't recommend actually eating it yourself! 3, 2, 1! Link's up!
The product link appears, and it sells out instantly. Poffy's eyes crinkle with delight as she laughs and makes teasing comments.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Haha, I knew you guys would perk up at the mention of pranks. Huh? Make my assistant try some?
Poffy waves her hand dismissively, feigning a serious expression as she speaks.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Nah! Took me long enough to find the right assistant. Don't wanna have to look for a new one so soon!
You cooperatively hold up a sign pleading for mercy, and she smoothly takes the grand finale from your hands. A smoking black pudding.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Last but not least, here comes our final product! This is a real treat from our sponsor. Don't miss out!
Poffy takes a big bite, pauses for a few seconds, then smiles and gives a thumbs up while flashing two rows of now completely blackened teeth.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: It might look icky, but it tastes surprisingly good! The bitter richness of cocoa mingles with the sweet crunch of wafer. Underneath its tough exterior, the inside's actually soft and delicious! See, it even turns your teeth black so you can take the perfect goofy selfies! Hehe!

And with a few rapid taps, Poffy snaps six selfies with her blackened teeth. The chat is exploding with comments and likes. Next to her, you hold up the next prop, but a heaviness settles in your chest.

steps.speaker: Coordinator
steps.content: Hey, check the comments.
The coordinator leans over to direct the manager's attention to the screen. You move closer as well, and several harsh comments immediately catch your eye...

steps.speaker: AAA Foodie
steps.content: When did she get so fat? Has she been gorging herself?

steps.speaker: Notice_Me
steps.content: She's so fat it's making her ads less appealing.

steps.speaker: BreadCart
steps.content: I should go on a diet so I don't end up like her.
The sponsor's expression darkens considerably, and the manager quickly gives an apologetic smile.

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: Sure, the comments aren't exactly nice, but look at the engagements! Better to be talked about than ignored, right? Sales are through the roof too. That's what really matters, isn't it?
The tension eases slightly, but the manager immediately turns back to throw a stern glare at Poffy.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So this is what being a food streamer is really like. Constantly pushing boundaries and even humiliating yourself for attention... It’s so far from her original, simple wish to just eat what she wanted.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What a shame everyone here has long grown accustomed to this culture. No one cares anymore.

You watch Poffy in front of the camera. She looks like a wound-up doll, mouth curved in a smile while her eyes are hollow. You finally understand what she meant when she said you'll see for yourself in a bit.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It seems that whatever passion you have, once it becomes work, it gets ruined a little.
[Scene Change]
The two-hour stream finally ends, and Poffy lets out a long breath, like a soldier retreating from battle.
She drags herself back to the dressing room with heavy steps. You offer her a handkerchief, and she manages a weak smile as she wipes her hands, exhaustion filling her eyes.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: The taste was... well, hard to describe, but at least I got a full meal out of it, hehe.
Not wanting you to worry, she gives her belly a playful pat, trying to keep the mood light.
The next second, her manager storms over in a rage, hurling a thick stack of reports at her—

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: Take a good look yourself! The comments were all calling you fat and ugly! Nobody even mentioned the products!
Poffy frantically crouches down to pick up the scattered sheets. Her fingertips tremble so badly she can barely grasp them, her eyes locked on those harsh comments.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I... I already tried my best to promote them...
Her voice sounds feeble, as if defending herself against the agent, but also against herself.

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: Tried your best? How many projects has the company set up for you? We've tried every single gimmick to get attention, and yet you're still getting crushed by that pretty girl from Hummingbird Entertainment!

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: How many times have I told you to lose weight?! People don't want to see another fat girl doing mukbang! Get any bigger and your career is over!
Those words seem to trigger something buried deep within Poffy. She whips around as if struck by a bolt of lightning, rushing toward the bathroom unsteadily.

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: Still running away? I don't know what I was thinking when I signed you! Once I'm done with my other tasks, I'll deal with you properly...
It isn't until the manager gets called away by the coordinator that your ears finally have some peace.
You follow Poffy, initially thinking she is just escaping from her manager's verbal abuse, but then you hear someone dry heaving in the bathroom.
[Scene transition, rest area]

When you arrive, Poffy keeps rinsing her hands in the basin. Even though her stomach has already been emptied, her body seems to be protesting habitually, forcing her to purge every last bit of what it deems excess.
Seeing you approach, she hastily wipes her face with the back of her hand, then buries her face in her palms and begins to cry with quiet, restrained sobs filled with anguish.
As if she's afraid of being heard, her sobs are so quiet they're nearly drowned out by the running water, yet they carry a suffocating despair.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: It should be a happy thing to have my stomach full... So why does it cause me so much pain now?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I don't want to throw up, but my body's gotten used to it... I've always been a chubby girl, and back then everyone liked me... Why has it changed now...

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Why do I still have to lose weight even after I ran away from Mom? What am I supposed to do? I don't know anymore... Please tell me what to do... Chief...
You find yourself at a loss for words. All you can do is gently pat her on the back before leading her back to the makeup room to rest.
When the manager returns and catches the unpleasant smell lingering on Poffy, he pinches his nose disgustedly.

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: At least you figured out how to make yourself throw it all up.

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: We're shooting an eating contest next. We've fought hard for your spot, and your opponent is a skinny celebrity with a big appetite. If you want to win, you should keep your stomach empty now. The only way to gain views is by winning, got it?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: But I just threw everything up... That variety show takes hours to record. I'll go insane from hunger if I have to get through the whole thing on an empty stomach...
Poffy tries to explain, but the manager puts his hands on his hips and raises his voice.

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: How many times do I have to repeat myself? We need you to control your weight! Small-time streamers like you are a dime a dozen. You're lucky I even signed you!

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: I've given you plenty of opportunities and training, and helped you get exposure by putting you next to celebrities. And now you're getting picky with me?
Each cruel word crashes down on her like a blow. Poffy hangs her head and trembles, the gnawing emptiness in her stomach pushing her to the breaking point. You can feel her Mania stirring.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: No... I can't go hungry... I can't control it... I'll hurt people...

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I'll ruin everything!
The Mania in Poffy is fluctuating more vigorously, to the point you think that might be what's making the manager so cranky.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I'm sorry... for being so useless, Mom...

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Why can't I just lose weight... It's all my fault... I shouldn't have...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Poffy? Calm down!
Poffy's face is shrouded in shadow, her gaze unfocused, her words becoming incoherent. You remember what Poffy said in the interrogation room...

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Once she's starved past a certain point, the big bad Poffy will go rogue! Whether it's cupcakes or people, they'll all become my food!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: What's even more terrifying is that I don't simply become insane. I also lose all memory of what's happened during an outburst!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Ah!!
You grab Poffy's wrist and immediately use your shackles to stabilize her mind. She jolts sharply, then comes back to her senses.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Chief...
She calls out to you softly. You gently stroke her head to comfort her, then turn toward the manager who's still berating Poffy.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Did your parents never teach you any manners when talking to people?

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: You...!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you call this training, then talent managers are no different than livestock farmers.
The manager lets out a cold snort.

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: Poffy is one of the company's products, and unworthy products get replaced. That's just how the entertainment industry works.

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: All top celebrities are incredibly self-disciplined. Push yourself hard enough and become a superstar, then you get to be choosy with jobs.

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: Do you really think someone like her, who can't even control her own impulses, gets to haggle with me? Everything I do is for her own good.
Everything I do is for her own good. Hearing that familiar phrase, Poffy wraps her arms around herself, as if recalling some painful memories.
The manager leans in close to Poffy, flashing a malicious smile.

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: Of course, you could always give up and go home, as long as you can afford the price. I can sort out the paperwork for you right away. How about it?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: But... but you know full well I can't come up with that kind of money!

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: So you're actually not that dumb, huh? Then stop wasting time and get back to work!
The manager suddenly shoves Poffy hard. She bumps into you and cries out in pain. Ignoring her reaction, the manager orders you both to wait backstage before storming out and slamming the door.
The room falls quiet. Poffy sits on the floor with her knees drawn up to her chest, thanking you softly while that practiced smile still lingers at the corners of her mouth.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Thank you for standing up for me, Chief.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You don't have to force yourself to smile.
The smile slowly fades from Poffy's face. She hugs her knees tighter and buries her head in them.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Rest up. You've been working non-stop all day. Even I'm feeling a bit overwhelmed from just watching.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Or... if you're feeling upset, we can talk. You won't be able to win the contest in this state of mind.
Her voice is barely a whisper, soft as a feather falling to the ground.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I can talk about anything?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Of course. We can chat about your hobbies, your past, your dreams... anything you want.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: My dream... is just... to have my stomach full.
[Same Scene Transition]

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: My parents separated when I was very young, so I lived with Mom.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: She was a career woman who worked long hours and always came home late. I would often go hungry, waiting all day for her to return.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Even though we didn't have much money, Mom would gently coax me to sleep and protect me whenever Dad came to take me away.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Then one day, a talent scout came to us and said I was cute enough to work as a child model and actor. I became the breadwinner, and Mom quit her job to work as my manager.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: But my fame didn't last long. As soon as I hit puberty, my body changed, and so did Mom.
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Mom
steps.content: Nibella, the talent scout wanted you to stick to the slender beauty route. That way, you'll have countless modelling and commercial acting jobs lined up for you.

steps.speaker: Mom
steps.content: But look at you now. Your face, your arms, your legs... My god, you've become so chunky everywhere! Is this still my daughter?
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Mom
steps.content: Did you really bite someone from the filming crew on set?

steps.speaker: Mom
steps.content: Do you have any idea how hard it was to get you a spot on a variety show? You can't sing, you can't act, your body's out of shape, and you're getting older. How do you expect to survive in showbiz like this?

steps.speaker: Mom
steps.content: The videos and photos of you biting someone have gone viral! Do you know what people are saying about you? That you were on drugs, that you've lost your mind! I spent a fortune hiring people to delete the posts, and I had to bribe the crew so they wouldn't press charges.

steps.speaker: Nibella
steps.content: Mom, I was just hungry and feeling dizzy... I can hold a press conference or do a stream to explain everything!

steps.speaker: Mom
steps.content: Who'd care? People are only interested in catchy headlines and gossip! Now shut your mouth and go back to school for a few months until this all dies down!
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Mom
steps.content: Have you gone mad?! Have you not caused me enough trouble?! Too hungry so you hurt your classmates?! Can't you even control yourself?!

steps.speaker: Mom
steps.content: Now the school wants you to drop out to contain the fallout, and you can't return to showbiz either. The way I see it, you've completely ruined your life!

steps.speaker: Nibella
steps.content: ...Enough! Mom, do you think I did those things on purpose?

steps.speaker: Nibella
steps.content: If you hadn't left me alone at that filming location, if it wasn't for that shoot, I never would have...!

steps.speaker: Nibella
steps.content: No one in the crew cared about me. They dumped me in a place full of Corruptors. You have no idea how terrified I was! But what about you? You don't care about me either. You only care about squeezing more money out of them!

steps.speaker: Nibella
steps.content: Yes, I've gone mad, I'm a monster! I have rotting scars on my body that won't go away, I bite people, and when I get hungry, I lose my mind and hurt everyone around me! And I can't even remember what happened!

steps.speaker: Nibella
steps.content: You're the one who made me face that kind of danger alone. You're the one who turned me into a monster!
[End of Flashback]

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Later, Mom kicked me out, saying she didn't want to see me get captured by some strange organization for research.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I didn't know how to survive on my own. All these years, Mom took care of everything. I barely went to school, and I was jobless and penniless... Without money, I couldn't even afford food. I had to find a job.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: That's when I discovered I could make money by streaming myself eating. It sounded like the perfect job!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: But... after I signed with the company, everything changed...
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: Now that you've signed the contract, you have to do what we tell you. Viewers prefer slender girls. A little chubby might be okay, but never too fat. I've seen your old photos. You've got a pretty enough face. Don't waste your potential.

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: Poffy, your numbers have been absolutely terrible lately. Make sure you wear your waist trainer. When you're done with the stream, go throw it all up right away, got it? You need to stay nice and pretty if you want to make real money...

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: Trying to run again? Eastside is only so big, where do you think you can go? I don't care if you die from overeating today, you're still going to stream!
[End of Flashback]

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: They made me act like I was happy, but how do you fake happiness? Viewers like girls who are chubby in a cute way, but who gets to decide what that even means?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Life was hard. Work was hard. I didn't understand anything. I was just barely keeping my head above water through those years.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I thought I had finally escaped Mom's control... I was so overjoyed that I willingly walked into another cage. It turns out... Mom's not the only person who can hold the keys to my cage.
Poffy smiles bitterly, her clenched fists trembling.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: It's terrifying to be on an empty stomach. Hunger feels like a nightmarish shadow that keeps tightening around me, until I can't break free, until I can't even move...

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: But even eating my fill during streams is so painful... My body wants to throw it up reflexively. I worry that the fatter I get, the more people will reject me.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: The bigger my fear, the harder it becomes to control my power. Just like Mom and my manager said... what can I possibly achieve, if I can't even control myself?
You can almost see her as a small child, curled up hungry just like now, waiting for her mother to come home.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You left your mother because you were afraid of losing control of your power and hurting others, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Those are never your intentions, and you can't control those thoughts. You don't want anyone to suffer because of your hunger and fear, so you gorge yourself, trying to suppress the Mania in your body...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You don't know what else to do, so jumping from one extreme to another becomes your way of solving problems, am I right?
Poffy is silent for a moment, then nods.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I see.
You have to teach her to listen to her own needs, not just what others demand of her and think of her. You need to help her take back control of her own life.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Neither binge eating nor making yourself throw up solves the problem. They might even hurt you more. Your Mania is connected to your mental state, so what you need to focus on right now is making peace with your own feelings.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's not about handing control over to someone else who holds the keys, but taking them back into your own hands. Does that make sense to you?
Poffy looks completely bewildered, clearly not understanding a word.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Give me your snack bag.
She says okay softly and reluctantly hands over the small bag she's been clutching to her chest.
You deftly locate the pocket where she keeps her bubble gum and put a piece in her hand.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Go ahead, have it.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Huh...? Oh, okay.
Poffy begins chewing the bubble gum. The sweet taste fills her mouth, sending signals straight to her brain. The fresh dopamine effectively soothes her, gradually pushing down the negative feelings.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Now, blow a bubble.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Blow a bubble?
You nod.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And you can only stop when I say so.
Poffy doesn't understand any of this, but she trusts you.
The first time, you only let Poffy blow out one breath. She can't seem to hold a lot of air in her lungs, so the bubble bursts before it can even form properly.
The second time, you let Poffy take breaths and keep blowing continuously. The bubble grows enormous, but finally bursts with a loud pop, splattering gum all over her face.
Flustered, Poffy wipes her face, then confronts you huffily.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Are you messing with me?!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What makes you think that?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: The first time, you made me blow a bubble with just one breath, but how was that even possible?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: And then you made me keep blowing and blowing until the bubble got too big and burst!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Exactly. For you, that's precisely the point.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Both food and your special power are dangerous to you. And anything you can't control feels like a bubble waiting to burst, filling you with fear.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: When you're starving, you're like a bubble blown with just one breath, ready to burst at any moment. And when you can't stop eating, you're like a bubble that keeps being inflated, seemingly satisfied but when it finally pops, the one who gets hurt is really you.
Hearing the word burst, Poffy nervously covers her mouth and asks you in a small voice, the bubble gum still held between her teeth.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: So, so what should I do? It sounds like maybe blowing just one breath would still be better...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm not the one blowing the bubble. You are. I shouldn't be the one controlling the pace and pauses. It should be up to you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's okay if you don't understand it now. You'll figure it out through practice. This time, you decide when to stop.
Still a little confused, Poffy nods and unwraps a fresh piece of bubble gum. Slowly, gently, she blows another bubble.
This bubble doesn't keep growing larger, but instead moves with Poffy's breathing. Gently, it swells, and shrinks, then swells again in a repeating cycle, maintaining a delicate balance.

The girl's eyes widen as she stares at the bubble she's created. It's so small, so fragile, and yet so resilient. With each inhale and exhale, her appetite and fear seem firmly within her grasp, no longer impossible to face.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Mmph mmm... mmph mmph! (Chief, I did it!)
[Scene Change]
Inside the studio, the shooting of the eating contest officially begins.
Poffy takes a deep breath and steps onto the stage decorated to look like a restaurant. She's already ravenous, but she still has to push through the lengthy games and advertising segments.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Let's give it up for our contestant, rising streamer Poffy! Say hello to everyone!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Ah... Hello everyone, I'm Poffy. I'm ready and I won't let my fans down!

She forces a smile, mustering what energy she can. As the lesser-known guest, she's assigned all the humiliating performances: getting splashed with water, making silly faces, and duck-walking in circles. Meanwhile, the big star only needs to look pretty and smile in front of the camera.
You watch Poffy with growing concern as she pants heavily, her face deathly pale from hunger, yet she stubbornly pinches her own thighs to keep her Mania from clouding her mind.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Not yet... Still one more segment to go...

The host brings out a bunch of products for everyone to praise in creative ways, but Poffy's gaze instantly loses focus. In her eyes, the food looks like salvation itself, and she can't help but reach for it.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I'm so hungry... I have to eat something...

The Mania within Poffy stirs restlessly, tempting her to surrender to her desires. But amid this turmoil, she suddenly feels a warm connection pulling her back from the precipice she is about to fall from.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Ch... Chief...?
She instinctively looks down the stage, and amid the blurred crowd in the audience, she senses your presence with perfect clarity. Through the shackles, your spirit feels gentle yet unwavering.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Learn to control yourself instead of assuming I'm right and following me blindly just because I've offered a solution. Otherwise, you'll only turn me into that shadow hanging over your life after your mother and manager.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Alright, alright, don't look at me like that. I just want you to try handling it yourself first. If you've given it your best effort and still find it too difficult, then don't hesitate to ask me for help, okay?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Remember, you are not alone.
Under the spotlights, everyone is laughing and cheering, only you reach out in a silent language to ask her, isolated amid it all, if she needs help.
Poffy shakes her head determinedly.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Chief, you've already helped me once. This time... I want to help myself.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Breathe in... Breathe out... It's not that hard, you can do this...
She takes a few deep breaths, slowly sensing the Mania within her body. With each inhale and exhale, the madness and restlessness are being soothed and guided.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Breathe in... Breathe out... From now on, let's be friends, okay?
One minute, three minutes, ten minutes... The Mania gradually settles down. The progress is slow, but steadily effective.
After many deep breaths, she unclenches her tight fists, revealing crimson nail marks clearly visible on her palms. The girl finally manages a weak but resolved smile.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: ...And now! Let the eating contest begin!
She's made it through. On her own, this time.
